label: Early termination / penalties
description: Fees, penalties or lost money if the signer ends the contract early

label: Automatic renewal
description: The contract renews by itself unless the signer acts, often with a long notice deadline

label: Deposit / fee forfeiture
description: The signer can lose a deposit or prepaid fees, especially regardless of actual damage

label: One-sided liability / indemnity
description: The signer covers the other party's losses or carries responsibilities that normally belong to the other party

label: Rent / price increases
description: The other party can raise rent, salary deductions or prices, especially at any time or by any amount

label: Non-compete / restrictive covenants
description: Limits on where the signer can work, live, or what they can do during or after the contract

label: Notice periods
description: Long, strict or unusual notice requirements the signer must meet

label: Unilateral changes
description: The other party can change the terms without the signer's agreement
